finding: The original configure cache predicate uses canonical Swift String equality and can suppress a live same-cell update when the exact UTF-8 source changes. The correct shared renderer policy is downstream of this predicate, so it is never reached on that path.

sourcePolicy.existingRule: Exact UTF-8 comparison with marked-input and pending-local-change preservation.

checks: Optional chaining returns nil for an uncached cell; nil != true preserves initial rendering.
A cached source with equal UTF-8 bytes retains the original skip behavior unless native style, block type or content-size category changes.
Canonical-equivalent but UTF-8-different source reaches the existing attributed renderer and its exact shared policy.
The existing marked-input early return, shared renderer preservation, applied-only cache update, focus/history/selection, text observer and native authorization paths remain byte-identical.
No new test hook, presentation initializer, authority fixture, product dependency, source list or selector is introduced.
